Name: Pet Desktop Icons
Author: Russia0898
Description:
I got the image off of the Stardew Valley Wiki

It has all 10 base pets, they are all a bit squished, but it makes them look cute

Just download/extract, unzip the file, then right click game's shortcut >> Properties >> Web Document >> Change Icon ... >> then browse too and select the .ico file >> ok >> apply

or if you don't like reading check out the video (not my video) 

Have a lovely day :)
